<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ms">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Rekod Kehadiran Kokurikulum - SJK(T) Sepang</title>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf-autotable/3.8.2/jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js"></script>
<script>
// Pre-check jsPDF on load
window.addEventListener('load', function(){
  if(window.jspdf && window.jspdf.jsPDF){
    console.log('jsPDF ready');
  } else {
    console.warn('jsPDF not loaded, will retry');
  }
});
</script>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --p:#5B21B6;--p2:#7C3AED;--p3:#A78BFA;--p4:#EDE9FE;
  --gold:#F59E0B;--gold2:#FDE68A;
  --g:#16A34A;--r:#DC2626;--o:#EA580C;--t:#0D9488;--b:#2563EB;
  --bg:#F5F3FF;--card:#fff;--text:#1E1B4B;--muted:#6B7280;
  --border:#E5E7EB;--sh:0 4px 24px rgba(91,33,182,.13);--rad:14px;--rad2:10px
}
body{font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-size:14px;min-height:100vh}

/* ── HEADER ── */
.hd{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#3B0764 0%,#5B21B6 40%,#7C3AED 70%,#6D28D9 100%);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:200;box-shadow:0 4px 30px rgba(91,33,182,.45)}
.hd-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px 24px;max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto}
.logo{width:58px;height:58px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35));border-radius:6px}
.school-info{flex:1}
.school-name{color:#FFD700;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.3px;text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.school-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:11px;margin-top:2px}
.hd-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px}
.clock{color:#FFD700;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,.4);line-height:1}
.clock-date{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:10px}
.wx{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:20px;padding:3px 10px;color:#fff;font-size:11px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}

/* ── NAV ── */
.nav{background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.nav-inner{display:flex;max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px;overflow-x:auto}
.nav-tab{padding:10px 18px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);cursor:pointer;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .2s;user-select:none;letter-spacing:.2px}
.nav-tab:hover{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.nav-tab.active{color:#FFD700;border-bottom-color:#FFD700;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}

/* ── MAIN ── */
.main{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px}
.page{display:none}.page.active{display:block}

/* ── SECTION HDR ── */
.sec-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.sec-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--p);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.sec-title span{font-size:22px}

/* ── STATS GRID ── */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:22px}
.stat{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--rad);padding:18px 16px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--sh);border-top:4px solid var(--c,var(--p));transition:transform .2s;cursor:default}
.stat:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.stat-n{font-size:34px;font-weight:800;color:var(--c,var(--p));line-height:1;margin-bottom:4px}
.stat-l{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}

/* ── CARD ── */
.card{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--rad);box-shadow:var(--sh);overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:18px}
.card-hdr{padding:16px 22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #F3F0FF;flex-wrap:wrap}
.card-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--p);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.card-body{padding:18px 22px}

/* ── FORM ── */
.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
.fg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.flabel{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}
.fc{border:2px solid #E9E4FB;border-radius:var(--rad2);padding:10px 13px;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--text);outline:none;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;background:#FAFAFE;width:100%}
.fc:focus{border-color:var(--p2);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(124,58,237,.12);background:#fff}
select.fc{cursor:pointer}
textarea.fc{resize:vertical}

/* ── BUTTONS ── */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:var(--rad2);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:none;transition:all .18s;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.1px}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(0)}
.btn-p{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5B21B6,#7C3AED);color:#fff}
.btn-g{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#15803D,#22C55E);color:#fff}
.btn-r{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#B91C1C,#EF4444);color:#fff}
.btn-o{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#B45309,#F59E0B);color:#fff}
.btn-b{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1D4ED8,#60A5FA);color:#fff}
.btn-t{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0F766E,#2DD4BF);color:#fff}
.btn-pk{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#BE185D,#EC4899);color:#fff}
.btn-sm{padding:6px 12px;font-size:11.5px}
.btn-grp{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* ── MASA BUTTONS ── */
.masa-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.masa-row .fc{flex:1}
.masa-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:var(--rad2);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:none;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .2s}
.btn-masuk{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#166534,#22C55E);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(22,163,74,.3)}
.btn-keluar{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#991B1B,#EF4444);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(220,38,38,.3)}
.btn-masuk:hover,.btn-keluar:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}

/* ── TABLE ── */
.twrap{overflow-x:auto}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
th{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5B21B6,#7C3AED);color:#fff;padding:12px 13px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.2px}
th:first-child{border-radius:0}
td{padding:11px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid #F3F0FF;font-size:12.5px;vertical-align:middle}
tr:hover td{background:#F8F5FF}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}

/* ── BADGE ── */
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.bh{background:#DCFCE7;color:#15803D}
.bth{background:#FEE2E2;color:#B91C1C}
.bmc{background:#FFEDD5;color:#C2410C}
.bur{background:#CCFBF1;color:#0F766E}

/* ── SIG PAD ── */
.sig-wrap{border:2px dashed #A78BFA;border-radius:var(--rad2);background:#FAFAFF;padding:8px;text-align:center}
.sig-canvas{border-radius:8px;cursor:crosshair;background:#fff;display:block;width:100%;max-width:340px;margin:0 auto;touch-action:none}
.sig-lbl{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px}
.sig-thumb{max-width:90px;max-height:40px;border:1px solid #E5E7EB;border-radius:4px;background:#fff}

/* ── MODAL ── */
.mover{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(30,15,60,.6);z-index:500;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
.mover.open{display:flex}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;width:100%;max-width:560px;max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(91,33,182,.35);animation:slideUp .25s ease}
@keyframes slideUp{from{transform:translateY(28px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}
.mhdr{padding:18px 22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5B21B6,#7C3AED);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-radius:20px 20px 0 0}
.mtitle{font-size:15px;font-weight:800}
.mclose{background:none;border:none;color:#fff;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;padding:0;line-height:1;opacity:.8}
.mclose:hover{opacity:1}
.mbody{padding:22px}
.mfoot{padding:14px 22px;border-top:1px solid #F3F0FF;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px}

/* ── CHART BARS ── */
.bars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.bar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.bar-lbl{width:150px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);flex-shrink:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.bar-track{flex:1;background:#EDE9FE;border-radius:20px;height:26px;overflow:hidden}
.bar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;padding-right:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;min-width:36px;transition:width .8s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5B21B6,#A78BFA)}
.bar-pct{width:46px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--p);text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}

/* ── TAGS ── */
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:38px;gap:4px}
.tag-g{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EDE9FE,#DDD6FE);border:1px solid #C4B5FD;border-radius:30px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#4C1D95;margin:2px}
.tag-a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FFF7ED,#FED7AA);border:1px solid #FDBA74;border-radius:30px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#7C2D12;margin:2px}
.tag-l{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F0FDF4,#BBF7D0);border:1px solid #86EFAC;border-radius:30px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#14532D;margin:2px}
.del-x{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:#EF4444;font-size:14px;padding:0;line-height:1;font-weight:900}

/* ── DRIVE NOTICE ── */
.notice{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EFF6FF,#DBEAFE);border:1px solid #93C5FD;border-radius:var(--rad2);padding:14px 18px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:11px;margin-bottom:16px;font-size:12.5px;color:#1E40AF}
.notice a{color:#1D4ED8;font-weight:700}

/* ── TOAST ── */
.twrap2{position:fixed;bottom:22px;right:22px;z-index:999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.toast{background:#5B21B6;color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:var(--rad2);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(91,33,182,.4);animation:tIn .3s ease;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:210px}
.toast.ok{background:#15803D}.toast.err{background:#B91C1C}.toast.info{background:#1D4ED8}
@keyframes tIn{from{transform:translateX(110%);opacity:0}to{transform:translateX(0);opacity:1}}

/* ── DOT PULSE ── */
.dot{width:9px;height:9px;background:#22C55E;border-radius:50%;animation:pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;display:inline-block}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.5;transform:scale(1.5)}}

/* ── SEARCH ── */
.sinput{border:2px solid #E9E4FB;border-radius:30px;padding:9px 16px;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-size:13px;outline:none;transition:border-color .2s;width:210px}
.sinput:focus{border-color:var(--p2)}

/* ── 2COL ── */
.twocol{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
@media(max-width:768px){.twocol{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ── PDF MODAL ── */
.pdf-preview{border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid #EDE9FE;background:#F8F5FF;padding:0}
.pdf-pg{background:#fff;margin:12px;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(91,33,182,.1);overflow:hidden}
.pdf-hdr-bar{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5B21B6,#7C3AED);padding:14px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.pdf-hdr-bar img{width:44px;height:44px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:4px}
.pdf-hdr-text h2{color:#FFD700;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;margin:0}
.pdf-hdr-text p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:10px;margin:2px 0 0}
.pdf-gold-line{height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#F59E0B,#FDE68A,#F59E0B)}
.pdf-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr) auto;gap:8px;padding:12px 14px;background:#F8F5FF}
.pdf-stat{background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;text-align:center;border-top:3px solid var(--c,#5B21B6)}
.pdf-stat-n{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--c,#5B21B6)}
.pdf-stat-l{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}
.pdf-pct{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F59E0B,#FDE68A);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.pdf-pct-n{font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:#5B21B6}
.pdf-pct-l{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#92400E;text-transform:uppercase}
.pdf-guru-sec{margin:0 14px 14px}
.pdf-guru-hdr{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EDE9FE,#DDD6FE);border:1px solid #C4B5FD;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;padding:8px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.pdf-guru-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#4C1D95}
.pdf-guru-stat{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#7C3AED}
.pdf-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;border:1px solid #EDE9FE;border-top:none;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;overflow:hidden}
.pdf-table th{background:#5B21B6;color:#fff;padding:7px 10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-align:left}
.pdf-table td{padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;border-bottom:1px solid #F3F0FF}
.pdf-table tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#FAF8FF}
.pdf-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.pdf-sig{margin:0 14px 14px;background:#F9FAFB;border:1px solid #E5E7EB;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.pdf-sig-box{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.pdf-sig-lbl{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.pdf-sig-line{border-bottom:1.5px solid #D1D5DB;height:28px}

.empty{text-align:center;padding:36px;color:var(--muted)}
.empty-i{font-size:44px;margin-bottom:10px}

@media print{
  #pdfMover > div:first-child,
  #pdfMover > div:last-child{display:none!important}
  #pdfMover{background:#fff!important;padding:0!important}
  #pdfScrollArea{background:#fff!important;padding:0!important}
  #pdfPreview{box-shadow:none!important;max-width:100%!important;width:100%!important}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .hd-top{gap:10px}
  .clock{font-size:18px}
  .main{padding:14px}
  .fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- HEADER -->
<header class="hd">
  <div class="hd-top">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," class="logo" alt="Logo SJK(T) Sepang">
    <div class="school-info">
      <div class="school-name">S.J.K.(T) SEPANG</div>
      <div class="school-sub">Sistem Rekod Kehadiran Guru Kokurikulum</div>
    </div>
    <div class="hd-right">
      <div class="clock" id="clock">--:--:--</div>
      <div class="clock-date" id="cdate">--</div>
      <div class="wx" id="wx"><span id="wx-icon">🌤</span><span id="wx-txt">Memuat cuaca...</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="nav">
    <div class="nav-inner">
      <div class="nav-tab active" onclick="goPage('dashboard')">🏠 Utama</div>
      <div class="nav-tab" onclick="goPage('rekod')">📋 Rekod Kehadiran</div>
      <div class="nav-tab" onclick="goPage('analisis')">📊 Analisis</div>
      <div class="nav-tab" onclick="goPage('tetapan')">⚙️ Tetapan</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<main class="main">

<!-- ════════════ DASHBOARD ════════════ -->
<div class="page active" id="page-dashboard">
  <div class="sec-hdr">
    <div class="sec-title"><span class="dot"></span> Dashboard Ringkasan</div>
    <div class="btn-grp">
      <button class="btn btn-p" onclick="openAdd()">➕ Tambah Rekod</button>
      <button class="btn btn-o" onclick="openPdfPreview()">📄 Jana Laporan PDF</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="stats" id="dashStats"></div>
  <div class="twocol">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-hdr"><div class="card-title">📝 Rekod Terkini</div><button class="btn btn-sm btn-p" onclick="goPage('rekod')">Lihat Semua</button></div>
      <div class="twrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Tarikh</th><th>Masa Masuk</th><th>Masa Keluar</th><th>Guru</th><th>Aktiviti</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody id="recentTb"></tbody></table></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-hdr"><div class="card-title">🏆 Kehadiran Guru</div></div>
      <div class="card-body"><div class="bars" id="dashChart"></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ════════════ REKOD ════════════ -->
<div class="page" id="page-rekod">
  <div class="sec-hdr">
    <div class="sec-title"><span>📋</span> Rekod Kehadiran</div>
    <div class="btn-grp">
      <button class="btn btn-p" onclick="openAdd()">➕ Tambah Rekod</button>
      <button class="btn btn-o" onclick="openPdfPreview()">📄 Jana PDF</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px">
    <div class="card-body" style="padding:14px 18px">
      <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">
        <input type="text" class="sinput" placeholder="🔍 Cari guru / aktiviti..." id="srch" oninput="renderRekod()">
        <select class="fc" style="width:auto" id="fStat" onchange="renderRekod()">
          <option value="">Semua Status</option>
          <option>Hadir</option><option>Tidak Hadir</option><option>MC</option><option>Urusan Rasmi</option>
        </select>
        <select class="fc" style="width:auto" id="fGFilter" onchange="renderRekod()"><option value="">Semua Guru</option></select>
        <select class="fc" style="width:auto" id="fAFilter" onchange="renderRekod()"><option value="">Semua Aktiviti</option></select>
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-o" onclick="resetF()">🔄 Reset</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="twrap">
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Tarikh</th><th>Masa Masuk</th><th>Masa Keluar</th><th>Nama Guru</th><th>Aktiviti</th><th>Lokasi</th><th>Status</th><th>Tandatangan</th><th>Tindakan</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody id="rekodTb"></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ════════════ ANALISIS ════════════ -->
<div class="page" id="page-analisis">
  <div class="sec-hdr">
    <div class="sec-title"><span>📊</span> Analisis Kehadiran</div>
    <div class="btn-grp">
      <select class="fc" style="width:auto" id="aGuru" onchange="renderAnalisis()"><option value="">Semua Guru</option></select>
      <select class="fc" style="width:auto" id="aAkt" onchange="renderAnalisis()"><option value="">Semua Aktiviti</option></select>
      <button class="btn btn-o" onclick="openPdfPreview()">📄 Jana PDF</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="stats" id="aStats"></div>
  <div class="twocol">
    <div class="card"><div class="card-hdr"><div class="card-title">👤 Mengikut Guru</div></div><div class="card-body"><div class="bars" id="aChartG"></div></div></div>
    <div class="card"><div class="card-hdr"><div class="card-title">🏅 Mengikut Aktiviti</div></div><div class="card-body"><div class="bars" id="aChartA"></div></div></div>
  </div>

<!-- TOAST -->
<div class="twrap2" id="tw"></div>

<script>
// ══════════════ DATA ══════════════
let DB = {
  guru:['Pn. Meenakshi a/p Raju','En. Selvam s/o Muthu','Pn. Kavitha a/p Krishnan','En. Rajendran s/o Pillai','Pn. Thilaga a/p Subramaniam'],
  aktiviti:['Bola Sepak','Bahas Tamil','Persatuan Matematik','Kelab Sains','Bola Jaring','Silambam'],
  lokasi:['Padang Sekolah','Dewan Sekolah','Bilik Sains','Pusat Sumber','Gelanggang Badminton'],
  rekod:[]
};
let editIdx=null, sigCtx, sigOn=false;
const LOGO = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,';

function load(){const s=localStorage.getItem('sjkt_koku');if(s)DB=JSON.parse(s)}
function save(){
  localStorage.setItem('sjkt_koku',JSON.stringify(DB));
  scheduleAutoBackup();
}

// ── AUTO BACKUP ──
let autoBackupTimer=null;
let lastBackupCount=0;
function scheduleAutoBackup(){
  if(!autoBackupOn) return;
  clearTimeout(autoBackupTimer);
  autoBackupTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
    if(DB.rekod.length!==lastBackupCount){
      autoBackupJSON();
      lastBackupCount=DB.rekod.length;
    }
  },2000);
}

function autoBackupJSON(){
  try{
    const data=JSON.stringify(DB,null,2);
    const blob=new Blob([data],{type:'application/json'});
    const a=document.createElement('a');
    a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const now=new Date();
    a.download=`Koku_Kehadiran_Backup_${now.toISOString().slice(0,10)}.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    updateBackupStatus(now);
    toast('💾 Auto-backup disimpan ke komputer!','ok');
  }catch(e){
    console.error('Auto-backup gagal:',e);
  }
}

function updateBackupStatus(date){
  const el=document.getElementById('backupStatus');
  if(el){
    el.textContent='Backup terakhir: '+date.toLocaleString('ms-MY',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
    el.style.color='#16A34A';
  }
  localStorage.setItem('sjkt_last_backup',date.toISOString());
}

// ══════════════ CLOCK & WEATHER ══════════════
function tick(){
  const n=new Date();
  document.getElementById('clock').textContent=n.toLocaleTimeString('ms-MY',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit'});
  document.getElementById('cdate').textContent=n.toLocaleDateString('ms-MY',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
}
function getWeather(){
  fetch('https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=2.7297&longitude=101.7051&current=temperature_2m,weathercode&timezone=Asia/Kuala_Lumpur')
    .then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>{
      const c=d.current.weathercode,t=d.current.temperature_2m;
      const ic={0:'☀️',1:'🌤',2:'⛅',3:'☁️',45:'🌫',51:'🌦',61:'🌧',63:'🌧',80:'🌦',95:'⛈'};
      const lb={0:'Cerah',1:'Cerah Sebahagian',2:'Separa Berawan',3:'Berawan',45:'Kabus',51:'Gerimis',61:'Hujan Ringan',63:'Hujan',80:'Hujan Renyai',95:'Ribut Petir'};
      document.getElementById('wx-icon').textContent=ic[c]||'🌡';
      document.getElementById('wx-txt').textContent=`${lb[c]||'Cuaca'} ${t}°C`;
    }).catch(()=>{document.getElementById('wx-txt').textContent='Sepang, Selangor'});
}

// ══════════════ NAV ══════════════
function goPage(n){
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('page-'+n).classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(t=>{if(t.getAttribute('onclick').includes(n))t.classList.add('active')});
  if(n==='dashboard')renderDash();
  if(n==='rekod'){fillDrops();renderRekod();}
  if(n==='analisis'){fillDrops();renderAnalisis();}
  if(n==='tetapan')renderTetapan();
}

// ══════════════ DROPDOWNS ══════════════
function fillDrops(){
  ['fGFilter','aGuru'].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;
    const v=el.value;el.innerHTML='<option value="">Semua Guru</option>';
    DB.guru.forEach(g=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=o.textContent=g;el.appendChild(o)});
    el.value=v;
  });
  ['fAFilter','aAkt'].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;
    const v=el.value;el.innerHTML='<option value="">Semua Aktiviti</option>';
    DB.aktiviti.forEach(a=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=o.textContent=a;el.appendChild(o)});
    el.value=v;
  });
  ['fGuru'].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;
    const v=el.value;el.innerHTML='<option value="">-- Pilih Guru --</option>';
    DB.guru.forEach(g=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=o.textContent=g;el.appendChild(o)});
    el.value=v;
  });
  ['fAkt'].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;
    const v=el.value;el.innerHTML='<option value="">-- Pilih Aktiviti --</option>';
    DB.aktiviti.forEach(a=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=o.textContent=a;el.appendChild(o)});
    el.value=v;
  });
  const fL=document.getElementById('fLok');
  if(fL){const v=fL.value;fL.innerHTML='<option value="">-- Pilih Lokasi --</option>';DB.lokasi.forEach(l=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=o.textContent=l;fL.appendChild(o)});fL.value=v;}
}

// ══════════════ SIG PAD ══════════════
function initSig(){
  const c=document.getElementById('sigC');sigCtx=c.getContext('2d');
  sigCtx.strokeStyle='#3B0764';sigCtx.lineWidth=2.2;sigCtx.lineCap='round';sigCtx.lineJoin='round';
  function pos(e){const r=c.getBoundingClientRect(),sx=c.width/r.width,sy=c.height/r.height;
    return e.touches?{x:(e.touches[0].clientX-r.left)*sx,y:(e.touches[0].clientY-r.top)*sy}:{x:(e.clientX-r.left)*sx,y:(e.clientY-r.top)*sy};}
  c.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{sigOn=true;const p=pos(e);sigCtx.beginPath();sigCtx.moveTo(p.x,p.y)});
  c.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{if(!sigOn)return;const p=pos(e);sigCtx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);sigCtx.stroke()});
  c.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>sigOn=false);c.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>sigOn=false);
  c.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{e.preventDefault();sigOn=true;const p=pos(e);sigCtx.beginPath();sigCtx.moveTo(p.x,p.y)},{passive:false});
  c.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{e.preventDefault();if(!sigOn)return;const p=pos(e);sigCtx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);sigCtx.stroke()},{passive:false});
  c.addEventListener('touchend',()=>sigOn=false);
}
function clearSig(){sigCtx.clearRect(0,0,340,110)}
function getSig(){const c=document.getElementById('sigC'),b=document.createElement('canvas');b.width=c.width;b.height=c.height;return c.toDataURL()===b.toDataURL()?'':c.toDataURL()}
function loadSig(d){clearSig();if(!d)return;const i=new Image();i.onload=()=>sigCtx.drawImage(i,0,0);i.src=d}

// ══════════════ MODAL ══════════════
function openAdd(){
  editIdx=null;
  document.getElementById('mtitle').textContent='➕ Tambah Rekod Kehadiran';
  fillDrops();
  const n=new Date();
  document.getElementById('fGuru').value='';
  document.getElementById('fAkt').value='';
  document.getElementById('fLok').value='';
  document.getElementById('fSts').value='Hadir';
  document.getElementById('fTkh').value=n.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  document.getElementById('fMasuk').value='';
  document.getElementById('fKeluar').value='';
  document.getElementById('fCat').value='';
  clearSig();
  document.getElementById('mover').classList.add('open');
}
function openEdit(i){
  editIdx=i;const r=DB.rekod[i];
  document.getElementById('mtitle').textContent='✏️ Edit Rekod Kehadiran';
  fillDrops();
  document.getElementById('fGuru').value=r.guru;
  document.getElementById('fAkt').value=r.aktiviti;
  document.getElementById('fLok').value=r.lokasi||'';
  document.getElementById('fSts').value=r.status;
  document.getElementById('fTkh').value=r.tarikh;
  document.getElementById('fMasuk').value=r.masaMasuk||r.masa||'';
  document.getElementById('fKeluar').value=r.masaKeluar||'';
  document.getElementById('fCat').value=r.catatan||'';
  loadSig(r.tandatangan||'');
  document.getElementById('mover').classList.add('open');
}
function closeModal(){document.getElementById('mover').classList.remove('open')}
document.getElementById('mover').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='mover')closeModal()});

function stampMasuk(){const n=new Date();document.getElementById('fMasuk').value=n.toTimeString().slice(0,5);toast('🟢 Masa masuk: '+n.toTimeString().slice(0,5),'ok')}
function stampKeluar(){const n=new Date();document.getElementById('fKeluar').value=n.toTimeString().slice(0,5);toast('🔴 Masa keluar: '+n.toTimeString().slice(0,5),'ok')}

// ══════════════ SAVE ══════════════
function saveRek(){
  const guru=document.getElementById('fGuru').value;
  const akt=document.getElementById('fAkt').value;
  const tkh=document.getElementById('fTkh').value;
  if(!guru||!akt||!tkh){toast('Sila isi maklumat yang diperlukan!','err');return}
  const rec={
    id:editIdx!==null?DB.rekod[editIdx].id:Date.now(),
    guru,aktiviti:akt,lokasi:document.getElementById('fLok').value,
    status:document.getElementById('fSts').value,
    tarikh:tkh,masa:document.getElementById('fMasuk').value,
    masaMasuk:document.getElementById('fMasuk').value,
    masaKeluar:document.getElementById('fKeluar').value,
    catatan:document.getElementById('fCat').value,
    tandatangan:getSig()
  };
  if(editIdx!==null){DB.rekod[editIdx]=rec;toast('✅ Rekod dikemas kini!','ok')}
  else{DB.rekod.unshift(rec);toast('✅ Rekod ditambah!','ok')}
  save();closeModal();renderDash();renderRekod();
}

function delRek(i){if(!confirm('Padam rekod ini?'))return;DB.rekod.splice(i,1);save();renderRekod();renderDash();toast('🗑 Dipadam','err')}

// ══════════════ BADGE ══════════════
function badge(s){
  const m={'Hadir':'<span class="badge bh">✅ Hadir</span>','Tidak Hadir':'<span class="badge bth">❌ Tidak Hadir</span>','MC':'<span class="badge bmc">🏥 MC</span>','Urusan Rasmi':'<span class="badge bur">📋 Urusan Rasmi</span>'};
  return m[s]||s;
}

// ══════════════ RENDER DASHBOARD ══════════════
function renderDash(){
  const t=DB.rekod.length,h=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='Hadir').length,
    th=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='Tidak Hadir').length,
    mc=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='MC').length,
    p=t?Math.round(h/t*100):0;
  document.getElementById('dashStats').innerHTML=`
    <div class="stat" style="--c:#5B21B6"><div class="stat-n">${t}</div><div class="stat-l">Jumlah Rekod</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="--c:#16A34A"><div class="stat-n">${h}</div><div class="stat-l">Hadir</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="--c:#DC2626"><div class="stat-n">${th}</div><div class="stat-l">Tidak Hadir</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="--c:#EA580C"><div class="stat-n">${mc}</div><div class="stat-l">MC / Urusan</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="--c:#F59E0B"><div class="stat-n">${p}%</div><div class="stat-l">% Kehadiran</div></div>`;
  const tb=document.getElementById('recentTb');
  tb.innerHTML=DB.rekod.slice(0,6).map(r=>`<tr>
    <td><b>${r.tarikh}</b></td>
    <td style="color:#16A34A;font-weight:700">${r.masaMasuk||r.masa||'-'}</td>
    <td style="color:#DC2626;font-weight:700">${r.masaKeluar||'-'}</td>
    <td>${r.guru}</td><td>${r.aktiviti}</td><td>${badge(r.status)}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">Tiada rekod</td></tr>';
  renderBars(document.getElementById('dashChart'),DB.rekod);
}

// ══════════════ RENDER REKOD ══════════════
function filteredRek(){
  const s=(document.getElementById('srch')||{value:''}).value.toLowerCase();
  const fs=(document.getElementById('fStat')||{value:''}).value;
  const fg=(document.getElementById('fGFilter')||{value:''}).value;
  const fa=(document.getElementById('fAFilter')||{value:''}).value;
  return DB.rekod.filter(r=>{
    if(fs&&r.status!==fs)return false;
    if(fg&&r.guru!==fg)return false;
    if(fa&&r.aktiviti!==fa)return false;
    if(s&&!r.guru.toLowerCase().includes(s)&&!r.aktiviti.toLowerCase().includes(s)&&!(r.lokasi||'').toLowerCase().includes(s))return false;
    return true;
  });
}
function resetF(){document.getElementById('srch').value='';document.getElementById('fStat').value='';document.getElementById('fGFilter').value='';document.getElementById('fAFilter').value='';renderRekod()}
function renderRekod(){
  fillDrops();
  const recs=filteredRek();
  document.getElementById('rekodTb').innerHTML=recs.length?recs.map((r,i)=>{
    const ri=DB.rekod.indexOf(r);
    return`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><b>${r.tarikh}</b></td>
    <td style="color:#16A34A;font-weight:700">${r.masaMasuk||r.masa||'-'}</td>
    <td style="color:#DC2626;font-weight:700">${r.masaKeluar||'-'}</td>
    <td>👤 ${r.guru}</td><td>🏅 ${r.aktiviti}</td><td>📍 ${r.lokasi||'-'}</td>
    <td>${badge(r.status)}</td>
    <td>${r.tandatangan?`<img src="${r.tandatangan}" class="sig-thumb">`:'<span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:11px">Tiada</span>'}</td>
    <td><div style="display:flex;gap:5px"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-b" onclick="openEdit(${ri})">✏️</button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-r" onclick="delRek(${ri})">🗑</button></div></td></tr>`;
  }).join(''):`<tr><td colspan="10"><div class="empty"><div class="empty-i">📋</div>Tiada rekod dijumpai</div></td></tr>`;
}

// ══════════════ BARS CHART ══════════════
function renderBars(el,recs,colorFn){
  const gs={};DB.guru.forEach(g=>gs[g]={h:0,t:0});
  recs.forEach(r=>{if(gs[r.guru]){gs[r.guru].t++;if(r.status==='Hadir')gs[r.guru].h++}});
  const sorted=Object.entries(gs).filter(([,v])=>v.t>0).sort((a,b)=>b[1].h/b[1].t-a[1].h/a[1].t);
  el.innerHTML=sorted.length?sorted.map(([n,v])=>{
    const p=v.t?Math.round(v.h/v.t*100):0,short=n.split(' ').slice(-2).join(' ');
    return`<div class="bar-row"><div class="bar-lbl" title="${n}">${short}</div>
    <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${p}%">${v.h}/${v.t}</div></div>
    <div class="bar-pct">${p}%</div></div>`;
  }).join(''):'<div class="empty">Tiada data</div>';
}

// ══════════════ ANALISIS ══════════════
function renderAnalisis(){
  fillDrops();
  const fg=document.getElementById('aGuru').value,fa=document.getElementById('aAkt').value;
  let recs=DB.rekod;
  if(fg)recs=recs.filter(r=>r.guru===fg);
  if(fa)recs=recs.filter(r=>r.aktiviti===fa);
  const t=recs.length,h=recs.filter(r=>r.status==='Hadir').length,
    th=recs.filter(r=>r.status==='Tidak Hadir').length,
    mc=recs.filter(r=>r.status==='MC').length,
    ur=recs.filter(r=>r.status==='Urusan Rasmi').length,
    p=t?Math.round(h/t*100):0;
  document.getElementById('aStats').innerHTML=`
    <div class="stat" style="--c:#5B21B6"><div class="stat-n">${t}</div><div class="stat-l">Jumlah</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="--c:#16A34A"><div class="stat-n">${h}</div><div class="stat-l">Hadir</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="--c:#DC2626"><div class="stat-n">${th}</div><div class="stat-l">Tidak Hadir</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="--c:#EA580C"><div class="stat-n">${mc}</div><div class="stat-l">MC</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="--c:#0D9488"><div class="stat-n">${ur}</div><div class="stat-l">Urusan Rasmi</div></div>
    <div class="stat" style="--c:#F59E0B"><div class="stat-n">${p}%</div><div class="stat-l">% Hadir</div></div>`;
  renderBars(document.getElementById('aChartG'),recs);
  // Aktiviti chart
  const as={};DB.aktiviti.forEach(a=>as[a]={h:0,t:0});
  recs.forEach(r=>{if(as[r.aktiviti]){as[r.aktiviti].t++;if(r.status==='Hadir')as[r.aktiviti].h++}});
  const ac=document.getElementById('aChartA');
  const asorted=Object.entries(as).filter(([,v])=>v.t>0).sort((a,b)=>b[1].t-a[1].t);
  ac.innerHTML=asorted.length?asorted.map(([n,v])=>{
    const p=v.t?Math.round(v.h/v.t*100):0;
    return`<div class="bar-row"><div class="bar-lbl" title="${n}">${n}</div>
    <div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill" style="width:${p}%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#EA580C,#FCD34D)">${v.h}/${v.t}</div></div>
    <div class="bar-pct">${p}%</div></div>`;
  }).join(''):'<div class="empty">Tiada data</div>';
  document.getElementById('aTb').innerHTML=recs.length?recs.map((r,i)=>`<tr>
    <td>${i+1}</td><td><b>${r.tarikh}</b></td>
    <td style="color:#16A34A;font-weight:700">${r.masaMasuk||r.masa||'-'}</td>
    <td style="color:#DC2626;font-weight:700">${r.masaKeluar||'-'}</td>
    <td>${r.guru}</td><td>${r.aktiviti}</td><td>${r.lokasi||'-'}</td><td>${badge(r.status)}</td></tr>`).join('')
    :'<tr><td colspan="8" class="empty">Tiada rekod</td></tr>';
}

// ══════════════ TETAPAN ══════════════
let autoBackupOn = localStorage.getItem('sjkt_autobackup') !== 'off';

function toggleAutoBackup(){
  autoBackupOn = !autoBackupOn;
  localStorage.setItem('sjkt_autobackup', autoBackupOn ? 'on' : 'off');
  updateToggleUI();
  toast(autoBackupOn ? '✅ Auto-backup diaktifkan' : '⏸ Auto-backup dimatikan', autoBackupOn?'ok':'');
}

function updateToggleUI(){
  const track=document.getElementById('toggleTrack');
  const thumb=document.getElementById('toggleThumb');
  if(!track||!thumb) return;
  if(autoBackupOn){
    track.style.background='#16A34A';
    thumb.style.transform='translateX(20px)';
  } else {
    track.style.background='#D1D5DB';
    thumb.style.transform='translateX(0)';
  }
  // Update last backup time
  const last=localStorage.getItem('sjkt_last_backup');
  if(last){
    const d=new Date(last);
    const el=document.getElementById('backupStatus');
    if(el){
      el.textContent='Backup terakhir: '+d.toLocaleString('ms-MY',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
      el.style.color='#16A34A';
    }
  }
}

function renderTetapan(){
  document.getElementById('guruTags').innerHTML=DB.guru.map((g,i)=>`<span class="tag-g">👤 ${g}<button class="del-x" onclick="delGuru(${i})">×</button></span>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('aktTags').innerHTML=DB.aktiviti.map((a,i)=>`<span class="tag-a">🏅 ${a}<button class="del-x" onclick="delAkt(${i})">×</button></span>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('lokTags').innerHTML=DB.lokasi.map((l,i)=>`<span class="tag-l">📍 ${l}<button class="del-x" onclick="delLok(${i})">×</button></span>`).join('');
  setTimeout(updateToggleUI, 50);
}
function addGuru(){const v=document.getElementById('iGuru').value.trim();if(!v)return;if(DB.guru.includes(v)){toast('Sudah ada!','err');return}DB.guru.push(v);document.getElementById('iGuru').value='';save();renderTetapan();toast('✅ Guru ditambah','ok')}
function delGuru(i){if(!confirm(`Padam "${DB.guru[i]}"?`))return;DB.guru.splice(i,1);save();renderTetapan();toast('🗑 Dipadam','err')}
function addAkt(){const v=document.getElementById('iAkt').value.trim();if(!v)return;if(DB.aktiviti.includes(v)){toast('Sudah ada!','err');return}DB.aktiviti.push(v);document.getElementById('iAkt').value='';save();renderTetapan();toast('✅ Aktiviti ditambah','ok')}
function delAkt(i){if(!confirm(`Padam "${DB.aktiviti[i]}"?`))return;DB.aktiviti.splice(i,1);save();renderTetapan();toast('🗑 Dipadam','err')}
function addLok(){const v=document.getElementById('iLok').value.trim();if(!v)return;if(DB.lokasi.includes(v)){toast('Sudah ada!','err');return}DB.lokasi.push(v);document.getElementById('iLok').value='';save();renderTetapan();toast('✅ Lokasi ditambah','ok')}
function delLok(i){if(!confirm(`Padam "${DB.lokasi[i]}"?`))return;DB.lokasi.splice(i,1);save();renderTetapan();toast('🗑 Dipadam','err')}

// ══════════════ JSON ══════════════
function exportJSON(){const b=new Blob([JSON.stringify(DB,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(b);a.download=`Koku_Kehadiran_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.json`;a.click();toast('📥 JSON dieksport','ok')}
function importJSON(e){const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=ev=>{try{const d=JSON.parse(ev.target.result);if(!d.rekod||!d.guru)throw 0;if(!confirm(`Import? ${DB.rekod.length} rekod sedia akan diganti.`))return;DB=d;save();renderDash();toast('✅ Data diimport','ok')}catch{toast('❌ Fail tidak sah','err')}};r.readAsText(f)}
function clearAll(){if(!confirm('Padam SEMUA rekod?'))return;if(!confirm('Pasti? Tidak boleh diundur!'))return;DB.rekod=[];save();renderDash();toast('🗑 Semua rekod dipadam','err')}

// ══════════════ PDF PREVIEW ══════════════
function openPdfPreview(){
  const n=new Date();
  const t=DB.rekod.length,h=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='Hadir').length,
    th=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='Tidak Hadir').length,
    mc=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='MC').length,
    ur=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='Urusan Rasmi').length,
    p=t?Math.round(h/t*100):0;

  // Build grouped by guru
  const sorted=[...DB.rekod].sort((a,b)=>a.guru.localeCompare(b.guru)||a.tarikh.localeCompare(b.tarikh));
  const groups={};
  sorted.forEach(r=>{if(!groups[r.guru])groups[r.guru]=[];groups[r.guru].push(r)});

  const guruSecs=Object.entries(groups).map(([guru,recs])=>{
    const gH=recs.filter(r=>r.status==='Hadir').length,gT=recs.length,gP=gT?Math.round(gH/gT*100):0;
    const rows=recs.map((r,i)=>`
      <tr>
        <td style="text-align:center">${i+1}</td>
        <td>${r.tarikh}</td>
        <td>${r.aktiviti}</td>
        <td>${r.lokasi||'-'}</td>
        <td style="text-align:center;color:#16A34A;font-weight:700">${r.masaMasuk||r.masa||'-'}</td>
        <td style="text-align:center;color:#DC2626;font-weight:700">${r.masaKeluar||'-'}</td>
        <td style="text-align:center;font-weight:700;color:${r.status==='Hadir'?'#16A34A':r.status==='Tidak Hadir'?'#DC2626':r.status==='MC'?'#EA580C':'#0D9488'}">${r.status}</td>
        <td style="font-size:10px">${r.catatan||'-'}</td>
      </tr>`).join('');
    return`
      <div class="pdf-guru-sec">
        <div class="pdf-guru-hdr">
          <div class="pdf-guru-name">👤 ${guru}</div>
          <div class="pdf-guru-stat">Hadir: ${gH}/${gT} &nbsp;|&nbsp; ${gP}%</div>
        </div>
        <table class="pdf-table">
          <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Tarikh</th><th>Aktiviti Kokurikulum</th><th>Lokasi</th><th>Masa Masuk</th><th>Masa Keluar</th><th>Status</th><th>Catatan</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>${rows||'<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center;color:#9CA3AF;padding:10px">Tiada rekod</td></tr>'}</tbody>
        </table>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');

  const html=`
    <div class="pdf-pg">
      <div class="pdf-hdr-bar">
        <img src="${LOGO}" alt="Logo">
        <div class="pdf-hdr-text">
          <h2>S.J.K.(T) SEPANG</h2>
          <p>Sepang, Selangor Darul Ehsan</p>
          <p style="color:#FFD700;font-weight:700;font-size:11px;margin-top:3px">REKOD KEHADIRAN GURU KOKURIKULUM</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pdf-gold-line"></div>
      <div class="pdf-stats">
        <div class="pdf-stat" style="--c:#5B21B6"><div class="pdf-stat-n">${t}</div><div class="pdf-stat-l">Jumlah</div></div>
        <div class="pdf-stat" style="--c:#16A34A"><div class="pdf-stat-n">${h}</div><div class="pdf-stat-l">Hadir</div></div>
        <div class="pdf-stat" style="--c:#DC2626"><div class="pdf-stat-n">${th}</div><div class="pdf-stat-l">Tidak Hadir</div></div>
        <div class="pdf-stat" style="--c:#EA580C"><div class="pdf-stat-n">${mc+ur}</div><div class="pdf-stat-l">MC/Urusan</div></div>
        <div class="pdf-pct"><div class="pdf-pct-n">${p}%</div><div class="pdf-pct-l">Kadar Hadir</div></div>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:6px 14px 4px;font-size:10px;color:#9CA3AF;border-top:1px solid #F3F4F6">
        Dicetak: ${n.toLocaleString('ms-MY',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}
      </div>
      ${guruSecs||'<div style="padding:20px;text-align:center;color:#9CA3AF">Tiada rekod untuk dicetak</div>'}
      <div class="pdf-sig">
        <div class="pdf-sig-box"><div class="pdf-sig-lbl">Disediakan oleh</div><div class="pdf-sig-line"></div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#9CA3AF;margin-top:4px">Nama & Tandatangan</div></div>
        <div class="pdf-sig-box"><div class="pdf-sig-lbl">Disahkan oleh / Cop Rasmi</div><div class="pdf-sig-line"></div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#9CA3AF;margin-top:4px">Tarikh: ${n.toLocaleDateString('ms-MY')}</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  document.getElementById('pdfPreview').innerHTML=html;
  document.getElementById('pdfMover').style.display='flex';
  document.getElementById('pdfScrollArea').scrollTop=0;
  const tot=DB.rekod.length,h2=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='Hadir').length,p2=tot?Math.round(h2/tot*100):0;
  document.getElementById('pdfInfo').textContent=`Jumlah: ${tot} rekod  |  Hadir: ${h2}  |  ${p2}% kadar kehadiran  |  ${Object.keys(groups).length} guru`;
}
function closePdf(){document.getElementById('pdfMover').style.display='none'}

// ══════════════ DOWNLOAD PDF ══════════════
function downloadPDF(){
  // Show loading state on buttons
  document.querySelectorAll('[onclick="downloadPDF()"]').forEach(b=>{b.textContent='⏳ Menjana PDF...';b.disabled=true});
  
  function doDownload(){
    if(!window.jspdf || !window.jspdf.jsPDF){
      // Try loading again
      const s1=document.createElement('script');
      s1.src='https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js';
      s1.onload=()=>{
        const s2=document.createElement('script');
        s2.src='https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf-autotable/3.8.2/jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js';
        s2.onload=()=>setTimeout(doDownload,300);
        s2.onerror=()=>{toast('Gagal muatkan modul PDF. Sila periksa sambungan internet.','err');resetBtns()};
        document.head.appendChild(s2);
      };
      s1.onerror=()=>{toast('Gagal muatkan jsPDF. Sila periksa sambungan internet.','err');resetBtns()};
      document.head.appendChild(s1);
      toast('Memuat modul PDF...','info');
      return;
    }
    try { _doPDF(); }
    catch(err){ console.error(err); toast('Ralat semasa jana PDF: '+err.message,'err'); resetBtns(); }
  }
  
  function resetBtns(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[onclick="downloadPDF()"]').forEach(b=>{
      b.textContent=b.textContent.includes('Muat')?"⬇️ Muat Turun PDF":"⬇️ Muat Turun PDF";
      b.disabled=false;
    });
  }
  
  setTimeout(doDownload, 50);
}

function _doPDF(){
  if(!window.jspdf){toast('Modul PDF tidak tersedia!','err');return}
  const {jsPDF}=window.jspdf;
  const doc=new jsPDF({orientation:'portrait',unit:'mm',format:'a4'});
  const W=210,n=new Date();

  function drawHeader(){
    doc.setFillColor(74,31,184);doc.rect(0,0,W,36,'F');
    doc.setFillColor(245,158,11);doc.rect(0,36,W,2.5,'F');
    try{doc.addImage(LOGO,'JPEG',6,3,28,28);}catch(e){}
    doc.setFont('helvetica','bold');doc.setFontSize(14);doc.setTextColor(255,215,0);
    doc.text('S.J.K.(T) SEPANG',W/2,12,{align:'center'});
    doc.setFont('helvetica','normal');doc.setFontSize(8.5);doc.setTextColor(255,255,255);
    doc.text('Sepang, Selangor Darul Ehsan',W/2,19,{align:'center'});
    doc.setFont('helvetica','bold');doc.setFontSize(10.5);doc.setTextColor(255,215,0);
    doc.text('REKOD KEHADIRAN GURU KOKURIKULUM',W/2,28,{align:'center'});
  }
  function drawFooter(pg,tot){
    doc.setFont('helvetica','normal');doc.setFontSize(7);doc.setTextColor(180,180,180);
    doc.line(10,284,W-10,284);
    doc.text('Sistem Rekod Kehadiran Kokurikulum  |  S.J.K.(T) Sepang',10,289);
    doc.text(`Halaman ${pg} / ${tot}`,W-10,289,{align:'right'});
  }

  drawHeader();
  const t=DB.rekod.length,h=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='Hadir').length,
    th=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='Tidak Hadir').length,
    mc=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='MC').length,
    ur=DB.rekod.filter(r=>r.status==='Urusan Rasmi').length,
    p=t?Math.round(h/t*100):0;

  // Date info
  doc.setFont('helvetica','normal');doc.setFontSize(7.5);doc.setTextColor(130,130,130);
  doc.text(`Dicetak: ${n.toLocaleString('ms-MY',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}`,14,44);

  // Stat boxes
  const bw=36,bh=16,by=47,gap=3;
  [[t,'Jumlah',[91,33,182]],[h,'Hadir',[22,163,74]],[th,'Tidak Hadir',[220,38,38]],[mc+ur,'MC/Urusan',[234,88,12]]].forEach(([v,l,c],i)=>{
    const bx=14+i*(bw+gap);
    doc.setFillColor(...c);doc.roundedRect(bx,by,bw,bh,2,2,'F');
    doc.setFont('helvetica','bold');doc.setFontSize(13);doc.setTextColor(255,255,255);
    doc.text(String(v),bx+bw/2,by+9,{align:'center'});
    doc.setFont('helvetica','normal');doc.setFontSize(6);doc.setTextColor(220,220,255);
    doc.text(l,bx+bw/2,by+14,{align:'center'});
  });
  // % badge
  doc.setFillColor(245,158,11);doc.roundedRect(W-50,by,36,bh,2,2,'F');
  doc.setFont('helvetica','bold');doc.setFontSize(14);doc.setTextColor(74,31,184);
  doc.text(`${p}%`,W-32,by+9,{align:'center'});
  doc.setFont('helvetica','normal');doc.setFontSize(6);doc.setTextColor(120,60,0);
  doc.text('Kadar Hadir',W-32,by+14,{align:'center'});

  // Groups
  const sorted=[...DB.rekod].sort((a,b)=>a.guru.localeCompare(b.guru)||a.tarikh.localeCompare(b.tarikh));
  const groups={};sorted.forEach(r=>{if(!groups[r.guru])groups[r.guru]=[];groups[r.guru].push(r)});

  let y=by+bh+8;
  Object.entries(groups).forEach(([guru,recs])=>{
    if(y>252){doc.addPage();drawHeader();y=44;}
    // Guru header
    doc.setFillColor(237,233,254);doc.setDrawColor(196,181,253);doc.setLineWidth(0.4);
    doc.roundedRect(10,y,W-20,9,2,2,'FD');
    doc.setFont('helvetica','bold');doc.setFontSize(8.5);doc.setTextColor(76,29,149);
    doc.text(`  ${guru}`,13,y+6);
    const gH=recs.filter(r=>r.status==='Hadir').length,gT=recs.length,gP=gT?Math.round(gH/gT*100):0;
    doc.setFont('helvetica','normal');doc.setFontSize(7.5);doc.setTextColor(124,58,237);
    doc.text(`Hadir: ${gH}/${gT}  (${gP}%)`,W-12,y+6,{align:'right'});
    y+=11;
    doc.autoTable({
      startY:y,margin:{left:10,right:10},
      head:[['#','Tarikh','Aktiviti','Lokasi','Masa Masuk','Masa Keluar','Status','Catatan']],
      body:recs.map((r,i)=>[i+1,r.tarikh,r.aktiviti,r.lokasi||'-',r.masaMasuk||r.masa||'-',r.masaKeluar||'-',r.status,r.catatan||'-']),
      styles:{fontSize:7.5,cellPadding:[2,3],overflow:'linebreak'},
      headStyles:{fillColor:[91,33,182],textColor:255,fontStyle:'bold',fontSize:7.5,cellPadding:[2.5,3]},
      alternateRowStyles:{fillColor:[250,248,255]},
      columnStyles:{0:{cellWidth:7,halign:'center'},1:{cellWidth:22},2:{cellWidth:36},3:{cellWidth:26},4:{cellWidth:18,halign:'center'},5:{cellWidth:18,halign:'center'},6:{cellWidth:20,halign:'center'},7:{cellWidth:'auto'}},
      didParseCell(d){
        if(d.column.index===6&&d.section==='body'){
          const s=d.cell.raw;
          d.cell.styles.fontStyle='bold';
          d.cell.styles.textColor=s==='Hadir'?[22,163,74]:s==='Tidak Hadir'?[220,38,38]:s==='MC'?[234,88,12]:[13,148,136];
        }
      },
      didDrawPage(){drawHeader();}
    });
    y=doc.lastAutoTable.finalY+8;
  });

  if(!Object.keys(groups).length){
    doc.autoTable({startY:y,margin:{left:10,right:10},head:[['Tiada rekod']],body:[],headStyles:{fillColor:[200,200,200],textColor:100}});
  }

  // Signature
  let sy=doc.lastAutoTable?doc.lastAutoTable.finalY+10:y+10;
  if(sy>250){doc.addPage();drawHeader();sy=46;}
  doc.setFillColor(249,250,251);doc.setDrawColor(209,213,219);doc.setLineWidth(0.3);
  doc.roundedRect(10,sy,W-20,26,3,3,'FD');
  doc.setFont('helvetica','bold');doc.setFontSize(7.5);doc.setTextColor(91,33,182);
  doc.text('PENGESAHAN LAPORAN',W/2,sy+7,{align:'center'});
  doc.setFont('helvetica','normal');doc.setFontSize(7);doc.setTextColor(100,100,100);
  doc.text('Disediakan oleh:',16,sy+13);doc.line(16,sy+21,95,sy+21);
  doc.text('Nama & Tandatangan',16,sy+25);
  doc.text('Disahkan oleh / Cop Rasmi:',105,sy+13);doc.line(105,sy+21,W-14,sy+21);
  doc.text(`Tarikh: ${n.toLocaleDateString('ms-MY')}`,105,sy+25);

  // Footer all pages
  const tp=doc.internal.getNumberOfPages();
  for(let i=1;i<=tp;i++){doc.setPage(i);drawFooter(i,tp);}

  const fname=`Koku_Kehadiran_${n.toISOString().slice(0,10)}.pdf`;
  doc.save(fname);
  toast('📄 PDF "'+fname+'" berjaya dimuat turun!','ok');
  document.querySelectorAll('[onclick="downloadPDF()"]').forEach(b=>{b.textContent='⬇️ Muat Turun PDF';b.disabled=false});
  closePdf();
}

// ══════════════ TOAST ══════════════
function toast(msg,type=''){
  const w=document.getElementById('tw'),t=document.createElement('div');
  t.className='toast '+(type==='ok'?'ok':type==='err'?'err':type==='info'?'info':'');
  t.textContent=msg;w.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(()=>{t.style.opacity='0';t.style.transform='translateX(110%)';t.style.transition='all .3s';setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300)},3000);
}
